'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Tyler Vantilburg DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tyler Vantilburg]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Informal messy sheet. Objective ISB Operations. Best-effort from scan. Inventory blank archetype.

* '''Player:''' [[Tyler Vantilburg]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[ISB Operations / Reaching Out|ISB Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
